about_the_game:
Descend into a world of mystery, gold, and... explosions! 💥 
Play as a brave dwarven miner, delving ever deeper into the earth in search of ancient treasures buried beneath the stone. But beware — you’re not alone down there. From the shadows emerge deadly creatures, and your only line of defense is… bombs! 💣

Gameplay

Precision and timing are your greatest allies.
Plant explosives, plan your moves, and detonate at just the right moment to clear your path, shatter rocks, or blast through hordes of lurking monsters eager to drag you into the abyss.

With every stage, the challenge grows — but so do your options.
Unlock new skills, upgrade your arsenal, and explore a world that punishes mistakes but rewards courage and cleverness.

Progression and Customization

You’re not just a miner — you’re a master of explosions.
Develop your abilities through an extensive skill tree, allowing you to shape your playstyle however you want.
Will you focus on raw explosive power, precise detonations, or special bomb effects?
Every choice matters, and each new level brings you closer to becoming a true legend of the dwarven depths ⚒️.

Key Features:

  • Thrilling exploration and combat across diverse underground biomes

  • Dynamic explosion system and destructible environments

  • Deep skill tree and upgrade system

  • Expanding arsenal and unique gameplay combinations

  • Rewarding progression and ever-increasing challenges


Do you have the courage to descend into the darkness and prove that no treasure lies too deep?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Dual Core 2Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 3000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 2,5Ghz+ or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD or nVidia with 512MB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 600 MB available space

short_description: Throw bombs, upgrade your skills, and survive endless waves of enemies in this fast-paced roguelike action game. Build your explosive arsenal, discover powerful combos, and see how long you can stay alive!
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian
